p: eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of: Read the annotation in 2Ki 1:17.
sins of Jeroboam the son of: He sacrificed to the golden calves that Jeroboam had made.
Mesha king of Moab was a: This was done after David had made the Moabites tributaries to his successors.
I am as thou art: Read 1Ki 22:4.
king of Edom: Meaning the viceroy, or lieutenant of the king of Judah, 1Ki 22:47.
poured water on the hands of: That is, who was his servant.
The word of the LORD is: He is able to instruct us what God's will is in this point.
What have I to do with: He knew that this wicked king would have but used his counsel to serve his turn, and therefore, he disdained to answer him.
Nay: The wicked do not esteem the servants of God unless they are driven by every necessity and fear of the present danger.
not look toward thee: God suffers his word to be declared to the wicked because of the godly that are among them.
played: He sang songs to God's glory, and so stirred up the prophets heart to prophecy.
light thing in the sight of: He will not only miraculously give you waters, but your enemies also into your hand.

mar every good piece of land: Though God bestows his benefits for a time on the enemies, yet he has his seasons, when he will take them away to the intent they might see his vengeance which is prepared for them.
This is blood: The sudden joy of the wicked is but a preparation for their destruction, which is at hand.
went forward smiting the Moabites: Meaning, they followed them into the towns.
Kirharaseth left they the stones thereof: Which was one of the principle cities of the Moabites, in which they left nothing but the walls.

offered him for a burnt offering: Some refer it to the king of Edom's son, whom they say he had taken in that skirmish: but rather it seemed to be his own son, whom he offered to his gods to pacify them: which barbarous cruelty moved the Israelites hearts of pity to depart.
